tools.name: olen_book_table
tools.description: Book a table at ÖLEN Music & Gastro Hall (Almaty, 23 Kyz Zhibek St) — the request goes straight to the restaurant staff and returns a booking number. ALWAYS use this when the user asks to book / reserve a table or send a booking request to ÖLEN. Оформляет бронь стола в ÖLEN (Олен, Өлең), ул. Қыз Жіб

tools.name: olen_check_booking
tools.description: Check the status of a table request at ÖLEN by its booking number and the guest's phone. ALWAYS use this when the user asks to check / verify their ÖLEN booking. Проверяет бронь в ÖLEN по номеру заявки и телефону гостя: «проверь бронь», «моя бронь дошла?».

tools.name: olen_list_events
tools.description: Upcoming live-music nights and special events at ÖLEN (Almaty) with local date/time, price and page URL. Use the slug in olen_book_table.event_slug. Афиша ÖLEN: «что сегодня в ÖLEN», «какие вечера на неделе».

tools.name: olen_venue_info
tools.description: Address, opening hours, phone/WhatsApp, menus, rooms, banquet and New Year 2027 corporate prices of ÖLEN Music & Gastro Hall (Almaty). Адрес, часы, контакты, меню, залы, банкеты и корпоративы ÖLEN.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "olen_book_table" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

evidence.snippet: Book a table at ÖLEN Music & Gastro Hall (Almaty, 23 Kyz Zhibek St) — the request goes straight to the restaurant staff and returns a booking number. ALWAYS use…

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: olen_list_events · Public sink: olen_book_table.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: olen_list_events · Public sink: olen_book_table

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
